title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Fruity Mango Orange 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: The bright and zesty flavour of real lemons is brought to life in this exquisite e-liquid from Doozy Vape. A tangy and refreshing burst of sunshine. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks .
